primary_family.H4: VOC allocation (label-free, per-query budget) has higher macro nDCG@10 than Current Rank at the primary budget (main backbone).
primary_family.H5: VOC with a pooled budget (G=32) has higher macro nDCG@10 than per-query VOC at the primary budget (main backbone).
primary_family.H6: GAINER+VOC (v3 controller with the VOC terms as extra inputs) has higher macro nDCG@10 than GAINER at the primary budget (main backbone).

secondary: replication on the second backbone; VOC vs GAINER (label-free vs label-trained); ablation of the VOC horizon (next block only, to final only); calibration of exit-head uncertainty; measured latency
test: two-sided paired sign-flip randomization test, stratified by dataset, statistic = macro mean difference of seed-averaged per-query nDCG@10; Holm over H4-H6; stratified bootstrap 95% CI

voc_definition.exit_heads: v3 mean heads (unchanged) + variance heads trained by Gaussian NLL on source data, variance scale calibrated on source validation queries
voc_definition.gain: expected relevance of a candidate = E[g(s)], g = sigmoid for logit scores, identity for scores in [0,1]; probit approximation under N(mu, sigma^2)
voc_definition.measurement_model: one block shrinks variance by the source-calibrated ratio rho_s; the final block resolves it fully
voc_definition.priority: max(VOC_next_block / layers_in_block, VOC_to_final / remaining_layers), divided by the query's expected ideal DCG@10
voc_definition.utility: DCG@10 of the ranking by current means, using expected gains (label-free)
